city.caveat: This is the official city record as kept, without adjustments. It joins several observing sites over the years, and a move, a new instrument or the city growing around a station can shift readings (city growth mostly warms nights); NOAA's adjusted climate datasets correct for these. Treat any single number as approximate.

text.lede: Yesterday's high of 63°F was the 27th warmest November 13 high (tied) of 148 since 1877, the warmest since 2025.
text.p_yest: The high of 63°F was the 27th warmest November 13 high (tied) of 148 since 1877, the warmest since 2025. The normal high for the date is 54°F, and the record is 71°F (1999, 2025). The low of 27°F was typical for November 13.
text.t_rec: Winnemucca is setting record highs far faster than chance
text.p_rec: If Winnemucca's climate weren't changing, every year would have the same chance of holding a daily record. Since 2000, Winnemucca has set 60 standing record lows, close to the 66 that chance alone would give, and 140 record highs, far more than the 66 that chance alone would give. The 2020s hold the most record highs of any decade (63). Winnemucca's all-time high is 109°F, on July 11, 2002.
text.t_chg: Winnemucca's nights cooled over the long run but have warmed since 1986. Its days have warmed.
text.p_chg: Across 145 complete years: Winnemucca's average low has fallen −0.12°F per decade (95% range −0.18 to −0.06), about −1.8°F since 1878. Winnemucca's average high has risen +0.34°F per decade (95% range +0.28 to +0.41), about +5.1°F since 1878. The last 40 years tell a different story: since 1986, lows have risen +0.44°F per decade (95% range +0.09 to +0.79) and highs have risen +0.52°F per decade (95% range +0.11 to +0.94). The full record joins different observing sites over the years, and a move (for example, from the city to a cooler airport) can hide or exaggerate a long-run trend, so the recent decades are the clearer guide here.
text.t_mon: Lows rose in none; 6 months fell. Highs rose in 10 of 12 months.
text.t_rain: Rain and snow: no clear long-term change
text.p_rain: Winnemucca's yearly precipitation shows no clear long-term change (−0.01 inches per decade, a range that includes zero). The 1991–2020 normal is 8.3 inches a year. The wettest year was 1998 (16.10 in); the driest, 1954 (3.13 in).
